revenue_today.definition: Recognized company revenue in USD, America/Los_Angeles calendar day; excludes sales tax, refunds and pass-through amounts.
revenue_today.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

revenue_7d.definition: Recognized company revenue in USD for trailing 7 complete local days.
revenue_7d.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

revenue_30d.definition: Recognized company revenue in USD for trailing 30 complete local days.
revenue_30d.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

mrr.definition: Normalized monthly committed recurring revenue; exclude one-time licenses, pilot fees and merchandise sales.
mrr.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

customers.definition: Unique paying company customers in trailing 30 days, not accounts or free users.
customers.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

new_customers.definition: First-ever paying customers whose first recognized purchase falls in interval.
new_customers.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

active_users.definition: Distinct users with meaningful workflow activity in interval; definition/version required, pageviews excluded.
active_users.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

conversion_rate.definition: Explicit named numerator/eligible denominator for a stated funnel stage and cohort.
conversion_rate.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

average_order_value.definition: Net recognized sales value / completed paid orders in same period.
average_order_value.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

leads.definition: Deduplicated consent-compatible interested prospects, not scraped addresses.
leads.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

qualified_pipeline.definition: Value of qualified opportunities with buyer, need, scope and next step; not booked revenue.
qualified_pipeline.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

top_product.definition: Highest observed company contribution or revenue product in a comparable stated interval.
top_product.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

top_channel.definition: Highest attributed paying-customer contribution in comparable stated interval; unknown without attribution.
top_channel.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

cac.definition: Fully loaded attributable acquisition cost / new paying customers in matched interval.
cac.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

retention.definition: D1/D7/D30/M3/M6 meaningful activity or paid renewal by eligible acquisition cohort; denominator and censoring required.
retention.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

ai_cost.definition: Company-wide actual billed model cost in interval, separate from token/list-price estimates.
ai_cost.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

operating_cost.definition: Hosting, software, AI, contractors, salaries and other operating expense in interval; excludes duplicated direct cost.
operating_cost.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

profit.definition: Recognized revenue minus COGS, fulfillment, labor, fees and operating costs on a consistent basis.
profit.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

cash_collected.definition: Settled customer cash received, net refunds, distinct from recognized revenue.
cash_collected.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

traffic.definition: Visitors/sessions defined by source and period; not inferred from marketing output.
traffic.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

trials.definition: Distinct eligible trial starts, not founding-list subscriptions.
trials.source_required: Authoritative aggregate accounting/payment/POS data for finance; consent-appropriate product analytics for use; existing Growth records for pipeline. Confirm attribution/coverage first.

marketing_ai_list_equivalent.definition: All recorded marketing calls only; excludes company engineering/research/current audit; token estimates may apply. Not AI ROI or actual billed cost.
